key.name: show-application-name
key.summary: Name the exported menu after the application
key.description: GTK4 applications keep their menu in a header bar button rather than a menu bar, and that menu has no name of its own. When this is enabled the entry in the global menu is named after the application, which matches the name the panel already shows beside it. When it is disabled a neutral label is used instead, so the name is not repeated.
